name: Merge for DIAMONDS!
desc:
🔥 Push blocks together to create rarer blocks! 🔥

Welcome to Merge for Diamonds, the ultimate merging game where you combine blocks to create rare and powerful ones while collecting pets and upgrades along the way! 💎

⚡ Upgrades: Unlock powerful upgrades that make merging blocks even easier and faster!
🐣 Pets: Hatch eggs to unlock rare pets that help you earn more gems!
🔄 Trading: Trade with other players to get even rarer and more valuable pets!
🏅 Leaderboards: Unlock achievements and compete to reach the top of the leaderboards!
